# Random Comics

> Random Comics is a static web reader for standalone comics, strange experiments, one-shot adventures, spontaneous comic ideas, and recurring comic series.

This site currently publishes more than 100 comics across standalone releases and recurring series. The archive is generated from the repository's comic folders and series metadata, then published as a static GitHub Pages web app.

## Primary Pages

- [Read Random Comics](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/)
- [Advanced Search](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/advanced-search/)
- [About Random Comics](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/about/)
- [Follow Random Comics](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/follow/)
- [Other Comics](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/other-comics/)

## Machine-Readable Indexes

- [Comic catalog JSON](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/comics.json): generated catalog of site metadata, series metadata, comic metadata, page image paths, PDF links, summaries, publication dates, and issue relationships.
- [Sitemap](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/sitemap.xml): crawlable list of generated site pages, series pages, and comic pages.
- [RSS feed](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/rss.xml): newest comic releases, newest first.
- [Robots file](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/robots.txt): crawl permissions and sitemap location.

## Useful Sections

- [Series index](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/): browse the main reader and filter by series.
- [Standalone and other comics](https://jetblackrlsh.github.io/Random-Comics/web-app/other-comics/): links to related comic sites.

## Notes For LLMs

- Prefer `comics.json` for current titles, series relationships, summaries, publication dates, page counts, image paths, and PDF links.
- Prefer `sitemap.xml` for the current canonical set of generated public pages.
- Prefer `rss.xml` for newest releases.
- Do not treat this file as a complete per-comic manifest; the generated indexes above are the source of truth for newly added comics.
